authorization: 2026-10-18 user confirmed evaluation of the learned cross-Loop residual gate on reused datasets with sequence-level logical dependencies. The two-task, four-arm, 100k-step development matrix is the implementation scope selected for that request; not a user-specified numerical budget.

source.reuse: Original expression grammar, operators, generator functions and depth/length settings; deterministic split seeds and explicit cross-split exclusion. Causal LM adaptation, not NDR score reproduction.

evaluation_policy.primary: Fixed 100k endpoint at the training loop count; paired gate-minus-no-gate answer accuracy and answer+EOS exact match on IID and held-out greater depths, all rows retained.
evaluation_policy.secondary: Predeclared inference-round grid and stratification by dependency depth, syntactic depth, sequence length, joins and sibling depth imbalance. These strata are evaluations, never model inputs.
evaluation_policy.selection: No best-checkpoint or best-inference-depth selection on test pools.

limits: One data realization and initialization per task: development evidence, not seed-robust or natural-language generality.
u=.95 changes initial residual damping; no fixed-u scientific control, so learned adaptation is not isolated from initial damping.
ListOps selected-value dependency depth does not mean unselected operands can be ignored a priori.
Arithmetic retains author right-branch growth and multiplication-by-zero shortcuts; syntactic depth is not guaranteed effective dependency.
Both tasks keep the original length cap; report exact positional coverage and overlapping length strata before calling a depth effect.
Compared with NDR: causal GPT blocks, learned absolute positions, final answer+EOS CE, uniform recipe across four arms, fixed endpoint; no geometric attention, gate-specific dropout or ACT loss.

listops.recipe_source: Shared ordinary AdamW/CE development recipe informed by NDR Tables8/9; fixed across all four arms, no architecture-specific search. Width256/MLP1024, sufficient repeat budget; not exact author training reproduction.

arithmetic.recipe_source: Shared ordinary AdamW/CE development recipe informed by NDR Tables8/9; fixed across all four arms, no architecture-specific search. Width256/MLP1024, sufficient repeat budget; not exact author training reproduction.
